smoke.description: Fast CI guardrail over a small but non-trivial synthetic repository.

budgets.rationale: A local runtime must become healthy within the app's actionable startup window.
Catch runaway runtime memory before packaging; this is intentionally broad across CI hosts.
Detect obvious idle polling regressions without making heterogeneous CI hosts a hard gate.
Task history must remain interactive with retained task snapshots.
A bounded fixture index must complete rather than stall or grow without limit.
An unchanged incremental index must be materially bounded.
Working-tree review must remain responsive on the CI fixture.
Bounded single-file diff review must remain responsive on the CI fixture.
The deterministic local agent step must reach a safe checkpoint without hanging.

standard.description: Developer baseline for routine regression comparison.

budgets.rationale: Developer runtime startup safety ceiling.
Optimization target until signed-package profiling provides a stable host.
Idle runtime CPU optimization target; signed-package profiling will refine it.
Retained task history should remain interactive.
Initial local indexing must finish within a bounded background-operation window.
Unchanged re-index should avoid full index work.
Git review should remain interactive.
Bounded diff retrieval should remain interactive.
A deterministic provider step should finish well inside stuck-work thresholds.

large.description: Manual stress profile for large-repository trend discovery; not a heterogeneous CI gate.

budgets.rationale: Large retained state must still start within a bounded window.
Large-profile memory target pending signed-package profiling.
Idle CPU optimization target under the manual stress profile.
Large retained history should remain usable.
Stress indexing must terminate within a declared manual-run ceiling.
Warm indexing must remain bounded at the stress profile.
Git status must remain usable on the stress fixture.
Single-file review must remain usable on the stress fixture.
Deterministic steps must not approach live stuck-work deadlines.
